description: This file contains utility functions for comparing images, buffers, and text, including image diffing with support for different image formats and comparison options, used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: getComparator
methods.description: Returns a comparison function based on the provided MIME type.

methods.name: compareBuffersOrStrings
methods.description: Compares two buffers or strings and returns a result indicating differences.

methods.name: compareImages
methods.description: Compares two images (buffers) with options, returning differences or errors.

methods.name: validateBuffer
methods.description: Validates that a buffer is a valid PNG or JPEG image based on magic numbers.
